body:
Client UUID (that you were banned on): wCK23Sh5AwcHkNsAFUHpWHFFMhA=

Type of Punishment (if ban, name how long the ban is): I was banned for thirty days by Zac for death threats and I currently have 22 days left.

Reasoning to why your ban should be appealed: I'd like to first apologize for my immaturity and rudeness towards Zac during the course of these last seven days, he did not deserve to deal with my shit and he did anyway. I jumped to conclusions when I should of talked maturely to Zac about the situation first. I believe I should be appealed because I am a first time offender and I understand what I did was wrong and I did not treat Zac the way I should of. I think my ban was over exaggerated and I am asking for an appeal this one time.
